strings.text: The school’s awards page claims "26 BLUMEY Awards," but that figure counts nominations and finalist placements together with wins. Cross-checked against Blumenthal’s published winner lists, exactly one outright win is verifiable — Max Odom, 2022. PD is a consistent participant and a reliable producer of individual acting finalists, not a Blumey powerhouse: in 2025 and 2026 it placed 5–6 finalists each year, converted none, and appeared in no production-level category, while Northwest School of the Arts took three wins in 2026 alone. Its high-water mark was 2016–2022. Where the program does win is NCTC: Superior ratings in 2014, 2019 and 2022; Overall Regional Site Winner (Adjudicators’ Choice) for The Yellow Boat; Regional Site Winner (Audience Choice) for Radium Girls, which advanced to the State Festival and took state-level Lighting and Set Design honors; and Excellence in Directing in both 2023 and 2024.
strings.t: La página de premios de la escuela afirma “26 BLUMEY Awards”, pero esa cifra suma nominaciones y puestos de finalista junto con los premios. Cotejado con las listas de ganadores publicadas por Blumenthal, solo un premio en firme es verificable — Max Odom, 2022. PD participa de forma constante y produce con fiabilidad finalistas individuales de interpretación, pero no es una potencia en los Blumey: en 2025 y 2026 colocó de cinco a seis finalistas cada año, no convirtió ninguno y no apareció en ninguna categoría de producción, mientras que la Northwest School of the Arts se llevó tres premios solo en 2026. Su mejor momento fue entre 2016 y 2022. Donde el programa sí gana es en la NCTC: calificaciones de Superior en 2014, 2019 y 2022; Ganador Regional General (Elección del Jurado) por The Yellow Boat; Ganador Regional (Elección del Público) por Radium Girls, que pasó al Festival Estatal y obtuvo allí distinciones de Iluminación y Escenografía; y Excelencia en Dirección en 2023 y 2024.

strings.text: Alicia Long heads the performing arts program. The tech track is genuinely articulated and undersold: the backstage/technical course starts in Grade 6 — a year before the acting course — and the Upper School sequence runs Stagecraft I → Stagecraft II → Advanced Design, plus an after-school stagecraft option. It produced a 2025 Blumey nomination for Best Student Stage Manager. For a student who would rather build than perform, this is stronger than most peer schools publish.

strings.text: A Best Actress Blumey is the single most competitive individual honor in the region, and Latin has one — plus Best Featured Performer the same night. That is a genuine peak. But the trajectory since is modest: one stage-manager nomination in 2025, then zero nominations for Cabaret in 2026 against a 59-school field. Latin is a real participant, not a dominant one. Separately, no NCTC one-act festival results could be found anywhere — Latin’s competitive theatre identity is Blumey-based (musical), not NCTC-based (play festival). This ledger reflects four Blumenthal releases checked in one research pass and is a floor, not a complete history.
strings.t: Un Blumey a Mejor Actriz es el galardón individual más competido de la región, y Latin tiene uno — más Mejor Intérprete Destacado la misma noche. Ese es un techo real. Latin es una participante real, no una dominadora. Aparte, no se pudo encontrar ningún resultado del festival de piezas breves de la NCTC — la identidad competitiva teatral de Latin es Blumey (musical), no NCTC (festival de obras). strings.text: Richard Fletcher chairs visual arts; no other visual-arts faculty are named anywhere on the school’s pages, which refer only to "a team of dedicated and experienced art educators." strings.text: Your materials name Alicia Long, Richard Fletcher and an assistant band director — but no Director of Bands, orchestra director, choral director, theatre director or technical director. Who leads each ensemble, and how long have they been here?

strings.text: There are no auditioned or tiered ensembles published — no jazz band, no a cappella, no chamber or wind ensemble. How does a player already at All-State level keep progressing rather than coasting?

strings.text: Six studios — which media does each hold? Is there a kiln, a darkroom, a printmaking press, a dedicated dance studio? The Arts Facilities page is photos only, with no descriptive text.
strings.t: Seis talleres — ¿qué disciplinas alberga cada uno? ¿Hay horno, cuarto oscuro, prensa de grabado, sala de danza propia? La página de instalaciones artísticas son solo fotos, sin texto descriptivo.

strings.text: You cite over 80% arts participation. Does that count required Lower and Middle School arts classes, or only elective and ensemble enrollment — and what is the Upper School–only number?
strings.t: Citan más del 80% de participación en artes. ¿Eso cuenta las clases obligatorias de artes de la Lower y la Middle School, o solo las optativas y los conjuntos — y cuál es la cifra solo de la Upper School?

strings.text: The Center for Worship and Performing Arts opened in Fall 2017 as Phase 1 of the master campus plan — two storeys, roughly 20,500–20,800 sq ft, seating 518 per the architect. Beyond the main auditorium the contractor documents a black box theater, a scene shop for set construction and dressing rooms. None of those three appears on the school’s own pages, so confirm them on a tour — they are what separate this from a chapel that also does plays.
strings.t: El Center for Worship and Performing Arts se inauguró en otoño de 2017 como Fase 1 del plan director del campus — dos plantas, en torno a 1.900–1.930 m², con 518 butacas según el arquitecto. Más allá del auditorio principal, la constructora documenta un teatro de caja negra, un taller para construir decorados y camerinos. Ninguno de los tres aparece en las páginas de la propia escuela, así que conviene confirmarlos en la visita — son lo que distingue esto de una capilla en la que además se hace teatro.

strings.text: A parent, alumni, faculty and business organization with seven giving tiers from $50 to $7,500. It funds real line items rather than refreshments: mainstage lighting and technical effects, band and orchestra instrument inventory, commissioned compositions, guest artist visits, gallery and performance field trips, arts technology, and faculty professional development. Publishes a monthly newsletter, Opening Knights.
strings.t: Una organización de padres, exalumnos, profesorado y empresas con siete niveles de aportación, de 50 a 7.500 dólares. Financia partidas reales, no refrigerios: iluminación y efectos técnicos del escenario principal, inventario de instrumentos de banda y orquesta, composiciones por encargo, visitas de artistas invitados, salidas a galerías y espectáculos, tecnología artística y formación del profesorado. Publica un boletín mensual, Opening Knights.

strings.text: Two audition-only competition teams carry the competitive work: ACT 1 (high school) and ACT 2 (middle school). The tech track is better resourced than the school advertises — technical directing and stage management are two of the seven theatre electives, the venue includes a scene shop and dressing rooms per the contractor, and students place in technical categories externally (a CITA Technical Theatre Costume Design award, plus the 2013 Blumey win for Best Lighting Execution). Caution on personnel: the only theatre staff names findable anywhere date to a 2016 news post — Angela Tomaselli (ACT 1) and Conrad Bear (ACT 2) — and may be stale. No current director or technical director is published, and no faculty are named on any of the four branch pages.
strings.t: Dos equipos de competición solo por audición sostienen el trabajo competitivo: ACT 1 (secundaria) y ACT 2 (Middle School). El itinerario técnico está mejor dotado de lo que la escuela anuncia — la dirección técnica y la regiduría son dos de las siete optativas de teatro, el recinto incluye taller de escenografía y camerinos según la constructora, y los estudiantes se clasifican en categorías técnicas fuera del centro (un premio CITA de diseño de vestuario en teatro técnico, más el Blumey de 2013 a Mejor Ejecución de Iluminación). Cautela con el personal: los únicos nombres de teatro localizables datan de una noticia de 2016 — Angela Tomaselli (ACT 1) y Conrad Bear (ACT 2) — y pueden estar obsoletos. No se publica ningún director o director técnico actual, ni se nombra a docente alguno en ninguna de las cuatro páginas de rama.

strings.text: Productions are staged in the Center for Worship and Performing Arts, which also hosts weekly chapel and assemblies — a dual-purpose room by design. The black box theater gives the program a second space that does not compete with the chapel calendar.

strings.t: Un pleno de cuatro premios: Wells Fargo Best Musical, Mejor Conjunto/Coro, Mejor Ejecución Coreográfica y Mejor Ejecución de Iluminación — el premio de iluminación señala capacidad técnica, no solo buen canto. Campo: 17 escuelas.

strings.text: The 2013 Best Musical win is the program’s headline arts achievement and it is confirmed directly by Blumenthal Arts. But there has been no Blumey win, and no top-6 nomination, since — the 2024 Tarzan result is real and impressive as a whole-cast showing, yet it sits one tier below nomination, in a field that had grown from 17 schools to 50. The CITA record is the school’s most distinctive credential because the circuit suits its identity, but it rests on a single published year: 2016. The school describes CITA honors as earned "each year," and that framing has one data point behind it. Separately, no specific NCTC award could be found for any year.
strings.t: El premio a Mejor Musical de 2013 es el gran logro artístico del programa y está confirmado directamente por Blumenthal Arts. Pero desde entonces no ha habido ningún premio Blumey ni ninguna nominación entre las seis primeras — el resultado de Tarzan en 2024 es real e impresionante como actuación de todo el reparto, pero queda un escalón por debajo de la nominación, en un campo que había crecido de 17 a 50 escuelas. El historial CITA es su credencial más distintiva porque el circuito encaja con su identidad, pero se apoya en un único año publicado: 2016. La escuela describe los honores CITA como obtenidos “cada año”, y ese planteamiento tiene un solo dato detrás. Aparte, no se pudo encontrar ningún premio concreto de la NCTC en ningún año.

strings.text: No visual art or digital arts faculty are named on either branch page. A dedicated Digital Media Studio is named but not described — no size, equipment or station count, and no separate broadcast studio, green screen or recording booth is documented despite a Broadcasting course. The school calls the program "award-winning" and confirms participation in Scholastic Art & Writing, Festival in the Park and the Patriotic Art Competition, but not one individual visual-art award with a student name and year could be found — so no award counts appear here. strings.text: CCHS has NOT won a Blumey in either year — verified against Blumenthal’s own 2026 winners release, where the five individual performance awards went to North Lincoln, Carmel Christian, Northwest School of the Arts and Weddington. Recognition here is consistent and deep rather than victorious: ten placements across two years, with Maye Glessner recognised in both (Hodel in 2025, Dorothy in 2026). strings.t: CCHS NO ha ganado ningún Blumey en ninguno de los dos años — verificado con el propio comunicado de ganadores de 2026 de Blumenthal, donde los cinco premios individuales de interpretación fueron para North Lincoln, Carmel Christian, Northwest School of the Arts y Weddington. strings.text: Country Day is a consistent, credible Blumey contender rather than a current front-runner: nominated every year from 2022 through 2025, it converted that into zero wins after 2022, then drew a blank in 2026. Its high-water mark is genuinely strong — two wins including Best Direction. Individual performer development looks repeatable rather than lucky: Sabrina McGovern earned lead-category nominations in three consecutive cycles, and five different students placed in five performance categories in 2025. On NCTC, the school claims five state championships, but only one play title could be verified — The Crane Wife, a second consecutive championship, placing it in fall 2018 with the prior title in fall 2017 (title unknown). The other three years and titles could not be found, and Country Day did not place at the 2025 state festival, so all five predate 2025. Treat "five championships" as the school’s claim. The strongest independently verified credential here is about teaching, not trophies: NCTC named Jenny Goodfellow North Carolina’s 2022 K-12 Theatre Arts Educator — confirmed on NCTC’s own awards page. For scale, the NCTC festival draws 3,500+ students from 100+ schools across 130+ productions.
strings.t: Country Day es una aspirante Blumey constante y solvente más que una favorita actual: nominada todos los años de 2022 a 2025, convirtió eso en cero premios después de 2022 y luego se quedó en blanco en 2026. Su techo es realmente alto — dos premios, incluida la Mejor Dirección. El desarrollo de intérpretes individuales parece repetible y no fruto de la suerte: Sabrina McGovern obtuvo nominaciones en categorías protagonistas en tres ciclos consecutivos, y cinco estudiantes distintos se clasificaron en cinco categorías de interpretación en 2025. Sobre la NCTC, la escuela reivindica cinco campeonatos estatales, pero solo se pudo verificar el título de una obra — The Crane Wife, un segundo campeonato consecutivo, lo que lo sitúa en el otoño de 2018 con el anterior en el otoño de 2017 (título desconocido). Los otros tres años y títulos no se pudieron encontrar, y Country Day no se clasificó en el festival estatal de 2025, así que los cinco son anteriores a 2025. Trátese “cinco campeonatos” como una afirmación de la escuela. La credencial verificada de forma independiente más sólida tiene que ver con la enseñanza, no con los trofeos: la NCTC nombró a Jenny Goodfellow Educadora de Artes Escénicas K-12 de Carolina del Norte de 2022 — confirmado en la propia página de premios de la NCTC. Como referencia, el festival de la NCTC reúne a más de 3.500 estudiantes de más de 100 escuelas en más de 130 montajes.

strings.text: Assigned by the Head of School in spring 2022, the three arts directors plus Dr. Regina Nixon spent a year rebuilding Cannon’s artistic mission and vision, surveying students, faculty and parents through an "I like, I wish, I wonder" exercise. The result is meant as a North Star for curriculum and extracurricular decisions. Most schools’ arts pages are marketing; this is a dated process with named owners — and a good tour topic: what actually changed as a result?

strings.text: Andy Macdonald, Director of Theater Arts since 2012, teaches all three Upper School theater levels and directs both the fall one-acts and the winter musical. Rob Burlington, Director of Music Arts, is music director for the winter musical — so the Blumey-competing show is co-led by the theater and music directors. No technical director is named publicly. The tech story is instead structural: the catwalk above the stage lets students assist on rigging lighting, and the AV control room at the rear of the house was, in the school’s words, "specifically designed for students to assist in the technical side of productions." Note the catalog has no course titled "Acting" or "Stagecraft" despite the website naming them — the real sequence is Honors Theater I, II and Theater in Performance, which can also be entered by doing three company productions instead of the prerequisite.

strings.text: All of it happens in the Cindric Performing Arts Center on the Leck Family thrust stage, which extends into the audience on three sides. strings.text: Two things a parent should hold together. The record is real and consistent — a full sweep of all five performance categories in both 2023 and 2025 — but every located line sits under a "Finalists for…" heading, and no Cannon winner line was found in any year checked. Treat this as ten finalist placements, not ten awards. On NCTC, participation is structural and every-year, but no year-by-year regional placement, state advancement or named award could be found, so no ledger is shown for it — the festival draws 3,500+ students from 100+ schools across 130+ productions, with select plays advancing from regionals to state. The director’s own framing is notably not trophy-focused: he says the judges’ feedback and seeing other schools’ work is what makes the festival special. Blumey involvement appears to reach back to at least 2019, but that page is no longer readable.
strings.t: Dos cosas que unos padres deben sostener a la vez. El historial es real y constante — un pleno de las cinco categorías de interpretación tanto en 2023 como en 2025 — pero cada línea localizada figura bajo un encabezado de “Finalists for…”, y no se encontró ninguna línea de Cannon como ganadora en ningún año revisado. Trátese como diez puestos de finalista, no diez premios. En la NCTC la participación es estructural y anual, pero no se pudo encontrar ninguna clasificación regional, pase a la fase estatal ni premio con nombre propio en ningún año, así que no se muestra registro alguno — el festival reúne a más de 3.500 estudiantes de más de 100 escuelas en más de 130 montajes, y algunas obras pasan de las fases regionales a la estatal. El planteamiento del propio director no gira en torno a los trofeos: dice que lo que hace especial el festival son los comentarios del jurado y ver el trabajo de otras escuelas. La participación en los Blumey parece remontarse al menos a 2019, pero esa página ya no es legible.

strings.text: Krista Johns directs Visual Art — she joined in 2007, piloted TAB in the Lower School in 2011 and became director in 2022. Her framing of why choice-based works: "when you're creating work that's based on your own experiences and interests, and you're not comparing yourself to anyone next to you, you're more willing to try new things." No CDE or Media Arts instructor is named. Two caveats worth carrying to a tour: Media Arts is promoted on the website and cited as an AP prerequisite but has NO course entry in the 2025-26 catalog, and AP Studio Art's stated prerequisites name "Studio Arts I" and "Media Arts I," neither of which exists as a catalog course — so ask which courses actually satisfy AP entry. No external visual-arts recognition (Scholastic Art & Writing or otherwise) could be found for any year.
strings.t: Krista Johns dirige Arte Visual — se incorporó en 2007, puso en marcha el TAB en la Lower School en 2011 y pasó a dirigir el área en 2022. strings.text: No theatre director, musical director or drama teacher is named in any source, and the catalog does not attribute courses to faculty — notable given the school earned a Best Overall Direction nomination in 2023, which Blumenthal credits to the school rather than an individual. The Theatre Performance Ensemble is a select company; new students must audition, most class time is rehearsal, and there are after-school calls before performances. There is NO stagecraft or technical theatre course in the 2026-27 catalog — the nearest offering, Film Studies & Production, is video editing rather than stage tech. Students clearly build substantial multi-level scenery, and a Davidson Day student once won a scholarship for non-performing theater work, so backstage participation exists in some form; whether through a class, club or crew is unpublished.

strings.text: For a school this small, the Blumey record is real and better than the enrollment would predict — the 2023 nominations for Best Ensemble/Chorus and Best Overall Direction are program-level recognition, not just standout individuals. The flip side of small-school math is the upside for a student: mounting a full musical out of a very small student body means far fewer peers competing for a role. Two things a parent should note plainly: no NCTC participation, placement or award could be found anywhere, so the Blumeys are the whole external picture; and prior research attributing a production of "Matilda Jr." to this school was an error — that show was staged by the Davidson Community Players, a separate community theater company in the same town, so it is excluded here.
strings.t: Para un centro de este tamaño, el historial Blumey es real y mejor de lo que la matrícula haría prever — las nominaciones de 2023 a Mejor Conjunto/Coro y Mejor Dirección General son reconocimiento de nivel de programa, no solo de individuos destacados. La otra cara de las matemáticas de un centro pequeño es la ventaja para el estudiante: montar un musical completo con un alumnado muy reducido significa muchos menos rivales por un papel. Dos cosas que unos padres deben tener claras: no se pudo encontrar ninguna participación, clasificación ni premio de la NCTC en ninguna parte, así que los Blumey son todo el panorama externo; y una investigación anterior que atribuía a esta escuela un montaje de “Matilda Jr.” era un error — esa obra la representaron los Davidson Community Players, una compañía de teatro comunitario independiente de la misma localidad, así que queda excluida aquí.

strings.text: Anna Jernigan’s arc anchors the program: a 2024 Best Actor finalist placement (as Lily in Anastasia, per Blumenthal’s own labeling) became the 2026 Best Actress win for Footloose, which carried on to the national Jimmy Awards. strings.text: Travis Johnson chairs the Fine Arts Department (ext. 415). The Actors’ Conservatory Theatre operates as a dedicated programme within the school’s theatre offering.
strings.t: Travis Johnson dirige el Fine Arts Department (ext. 415). El Actors’ Conservatory Theatre funciona como programa propio dentro de la oferta teatral del colegio.

strings.text: The Pamela Kimbrell Warlick Visual & Performing Arts Center seats 550 and carries modern lighting and sound systems plus a professional dance studio — a substantial house for a school of 510 students.
strings.t: El Pamela Kimbrell Warlick Visual & Performing Arts Center tiene 550 butacas y cuenta con sistemas modernos de iluminación y sonido, además de un estudio de danza profesional — un aforo considerable para un colegio de 510 estudiantes.

strings.text: The school publishes no production titles, performance dates, cast sizes or theatre competition results, and it names no International Thespian Society troupe number despite chartering the society. So the *shape* of the programme is well documented while its *record* is not — this card deliberately carries no awards ledger rather than an empty one.
strings.t: El colegio no publica títulos de producciones, fechas de función, tamaños de reparto ni resultados de competiciones teatrales, y no indica ningún número de compañía de la International Thespian Society pese a haber constituido la sociedad. Así que la *forma* del programa está bien documentada mientras que su *trayectoria* no lo está — esta tarjeta deliberadamente no lleva ningún registro de premios en lugar de llevar uno vacío.

strings.text: Chorus students earned “superior” ratings in regional adjudications across six years, and the programme has sent students on to the UNC School of the Arts and Governor’s School.
strings.t: Los estudiantes de coro obtuvieron calificaciones de “superior” en certámenes regionales a lo largo de seis años, y el programa ha llevado a estudiantes hasta la UNC School of the Arts y la Governor’s School.

strings.text: Music is taught as a practice rather than a subject — the curriculum covers singing, movement, improvisation, reading, writing and performing.
strings.t: La música se enseña como una práctica más que como una asignatura — el plan de estudios abarca canto, movimiento, improvisación, lectura, escritura e interpretación.

strings.text: The school does not publish ensemble sizes, named all-state or all-district selections, festival ratings by year, or a music faculty roster beyond the department chair — so the ladder above is qualitative where a larger school would publish counts.
strings.t: El colegio no publica tamaños de los conjuntos, selecciones nominales all-state o all-district, calificaciones de festivales por año ni un listado del profesorado de música más allá del director del departamento — así que la escala anterior es cualitativa allí donde un colegio más grande publicaría recuentos.

strings.text: A four-step Upper School sequence ending at Visual Art IV Honors, taught across five media including ceramics and printmaking.
strings.t: Una secuencia de cuatro pasos en Upper School que culmina en Visual Art IV Honors, impartida en cinco medios, entre ellos cerámica y grabado.

strings.text: Portfolio development is named as part of the instruction, which is the practical difference between an art elective and a route to an art school — and the acceptance list bears it out.
strings.t: La elaboración del portafolio se nombra como parte de la enseñanza, que es la diferencia práctica entre una optativa de arte y una vía hacia una escuela de arte — y la lista de admisiones lo confirma.

strings.text: Named explicitly in the Upper School visual-arts description
strings.t: Nombrado explícitamente en la descripción de artes visuales de Upper School

strings.text: There is no AP Studio Art or AP Art History in the profile’s course table — Visual Art IV (H) is the terminal course, carrying the Honors +0.50 weighting rather than an AP +1.0. Cinema Studies, Creative Writing (H) and Yearbook sit alongside as arts-adjacent electives.
strings.t: No hay AP Studio Art ni AP Art History en la tabla de asignaturas del perfil — Visual Art IV (H) es la asignatura final, con la ponderación Honors de +0.50 en lugar de un AP de +1.0. Cinema Studies, Creative Writing (H) y Yearbook se sitúan al lado como optativas afines a las artes.

strings.text: Where the work goes

strings.text: Numerous Scholastic Art Awards, plus wins at national, regional and local competitions.
strings.t: Numerosos Scholastic Art Awards, además de premios en competiciones nacionales, regionales y locales.

strings.text: The student literary and art magazine publishes illustrations, paintings and photographs alongside written work, and has taken numerous Scholastic Art and Writing Awards and repeated recognition in the NC Scholastic Media Association Literary Magazine Contest.
strings.t: La revista estudiantil de literatura y arte publica ilustraciones, pinturas y fotografías junto a los textos, y ha obtenido numerosos Scholastic Art and Writing Awards y reconocimiento repetido en el NC Scholastic Media Association Literary Magazine Contest.

strings.text: The 2019–2025 acceptance list includes RISD, SCAD, School of Visual Arts, Maryland Institute College of Art, the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, Minneapolis College of Art and Design and UNC School of the Arts — seven specialty art and design institutions.
strings.t: La lista de admisiones 2019–2025 incluye RISD, SCAD, School of Visual Arts, Maryland Institute College of Art, la School of the Art Institute of Chicago, el Minneapolis College of Art and Design y la UNC School of the Arts — siete instituciones especializadas en arte y diseño.

strings.text: The department is chaired by Travis Johnson; no other arts faculty are named publicly. The school publishes no gallery or exhibition calendar, no count of Scholastic awards by year and no named student winners — "numerous" is the school’s own word and is reproduced rather than quantified.
strings.t: El departamento lo dirige Travis Johnson; no se nombra públicamente a ningún otro docente de artes. El colegio no publica ningún calendario de galería o exposiciones, ni recuento de premios Scholastic por año, ni nombres de estudiantes premiados — "numerous" es la propia palabra del colegio y se reproduce en lugar de cuantificarse.

strings.text: A serious arts programme for a 510-student school — a named 550-seat centre, a six-year adjudication record, and a student magazine with a national award history.
strings.t: Un programa artístico serio para un colegio de 510 estudiantes — un centro con nombre propio y 550 butacas, una trayectoria de seis años en certámenes y una revista estudiantil con historial de premios nacionales.

strings.text: What is missing is the record rather than the programme: almost nothing is published by year, by title or by name.
strings.t: Lo que falta es el registro más que el programa: casi nada se publica por año, por título ni por nombre.
